description:
As a customer, I want to sort the products.

* Sorting should work properly.

cases.title: Products are ordered correctly by the selected sort option
cases.preconditions: Access to <the product list screen that offers sorting>, which shows <at least 3 products whose values for the chosen sort option differ>.
steps: Select <one sort option offered by the product list>.
Read the product order shown, from first to last.
cases.expected: The products are displayed ordered according to the selected sort option. The exact option names, direction and any ordering of equal values are not specified in the story.

cases.title: Changing the sort option re-orders the products
cases.preconditions: Access to <the product list screen that offers sorting>, which shows <at least 3 products whose values differ for both sort options used below>; at least two sort options are offered.
steps: Select <a first sort option offered by the product list> and note the product order.
Select <a second, different sort option offered by the product list>.
Read the product order shown, from first to last.
cases.expected: The product order is updated to match the second sort option; the order from the first option is no longer applied.

cases.title: Sorting a product list that contains a single product
cases.preconditions: Access to <a product list screen that offers sorting and currently shows exactly one product>.
steps: Open the product list screen showing exactly one product.
Select <one sort option offered by the product list>.
cases.expected: The single product is still listed and no error occurs. Nothing further is specified in the story.

cases.title: Sorting a product list that contains no products
cases.preconditions: Access to <a product list screen that offers sorting and currently shows no products>.
steps: Open the product list screen with no products in it.
Select <one sort option offered by the product list>.
cases.expected: No error occurs and the list remains empty. The exact behaviour and any message for an empty list is not specified in the story.
